title: The AI ideas ask the owner to send renewal and come-back reminders the automatic reminders already send
what: The 'Plan ends soon' and 'Plan ended' automatic reminders are on by default and go to members' phones before and after the last day. The Today for you ideas still say 'Plans ending this week: N, Write a renewal reminder' and 'Plans ended in the last 30 days: N, Write a come-back offer' for the same members, and 'Not seen for 10+ days' even when the automatic 'We haven't seen you' reminder is on. Only the birthday idea checks its automatic switch. An owner who follows the idea sends members a second reminder on top of the automatic one.
expected: With an automatic reminder on, the matching idea leaves out the members it already reaches (as the birthday idea does), or says the automatic reminder covers them.
who: owners with automatic reminders on (the default)
fix_line: Make the renewal, come-back and not-seen ideas read the automatic reminder switches like the birthday idea

title: An AI idea stays after the owner has acted on it, inviting the same reminder twice
what: After the owner taps 'Write a renewal reminder' or 'Write a fee reminder' and sends it, the idea stays on Today and in the assistant with the same count for the rest of the day and the week. The ideas have no done mark and never look at the messages already sent, though the assistant loads that list. The message card only warns about how many messages went today, not that this same group was just reminded. A second staff member or the owner on another device sees the idea as still waiting.
expected: Once a reminder from an idea is sent, the idea shows it was done today (for every device and staff member, read from the server's sent messages) or drops those members.
how_often: every time an idea is used
fix_line: Let each idea check the server's sent messages and show 'sent today' instead of asking again

title: A message set for later says 'Sent' at once, and its WhatsApp half is handed out straight away
what: When the owner picks a later day and time, the button reads 'Send on 15 Nov, 8:00 am', but the card then says 'Sent to N in the app' and History marks the task Done, as if it went. The members without the app are put on the WhatsApp list right away, so they get it today while app members get it on the chosen day. Nothing in the assistant later says the timed message actually went.
expected: The card says 'Will go on <day, time> to N in the app' and the WhatsApp list waits for that day or says it is early; the Messages page is pointed to as the record of when it went.
who: owners who send a message later
fix_line: Word a timed message as booked, not sent, and hold the WhatsApp list until its day
